question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel acknowledgment-reaction selector, and should its first supported mode be deterministic configured-list selection rather than model-driven context selection?
rationale: The request adds a public config and channel-behavior contract; deterministic, random, rule-based, and model-driven selection have materially different predictability, latency, validation, and failure semantics.

options.title: Add deterministic list selection
options.body: Preserve existing strings and add an opt-in list with a documented stable selection rule plus per-channel validation and fallback tests.

options.title: Keep one configured reaction
options.body: Retain the current account/channel/global single-reaction contract and avoid another configuration surface.

options.title: Design contextual model selection
options.body: Introduce a pre-dispatch model or rule hook and explicitly own its added latency, cost, failures, and plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Add deterministic list selection
recommendation.body: Preserve existing strings and add an opt-in list with a documented stable selection rule plus per-channel validation and fallback tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the latest shipped expansion of this exact configuration surface and are the strongest available owner for deciding whether it should expand again.
